notes:
Built 2026-10-05. pacificfusion.com has no ToS prohibition found (probe newsrooms.md); resources pages fetched from www.pacificfusion.com.
- Series A: the company's own Oct 25 2024 post says 'more than $900 million ... to date', committed upfront and unlocked by milestones (tranche structure). It is a commitment, not cash received; amount is qualifier 'over'. Later statements (Power Magazine 2026-06-02 quoting CTO; TechCrunch 2026-08-15) say the Series A is $1B or 'topped $1 billion'; recorded as a separate cumulative-kind event so it is not summed with the $900M. No new money event after Series A is evidenced. Reviewer: find a primary source for the >$1B figure (no company post found).
- Participants: the company post lists the syndicate without per-investor amounts. Reid Hoffman is named by EnergyCentral (reported) but not in the company's own list; Lightspeed appears as 'Lightspeed' in the company post.
- No Form D by Pacific Fusion Corp. (EDGAR full-text search returned only 'AVSF - Pacific Fusion 2025, LLC', CIK 2065481, a 2025-04-25 Form D that looks like an investor SPV; not recorded as a company event).
- Public money: Albuquerque package approved by the city council 2025-09-15 (CityDesk 2025-09-26): $10M direct incentives plus $776.6M of tax breaks / industrial revenue bonds over 20 years, with job-creation milestones and clawback. KRQE reports the cash part as $9M of LEDA funds, KOB as $10M of economic development funds: conflict, recorded $10M (CityDesk) with the $9M noted as evidence 'amount_conflict'. The $776.6M IRB / property-tax abatement is NOT recorded as an event (tax benefit, not cash; would swamp totals); Pacific Fusion's own Los Lunas release claims '$57 million in direct benefits to the state of New Mexico, Bernalillo and Valencia counties, and the cities of Albuquerque and Los Lunas' (News-Bulletin 2025-12-18, snapshot 82542ac5b4). Not recorded separately.
- Federal: no DOE Milestone, FIRE, INFUSE, ARPA-E or SBIR award to Pacific Fusion found (not in the DOE Milestone list of 8 awardees; ARPA-E JSON and SBIR probes had no hit). Collaborations with LLNL, Sandia (CRADAs) and NNSA (MOU) are recorded as agreements, no dollar value stated.
- Bloomberg and Wired coverage of the launch was not used (paywall). WebSearch budget exhausted; Business Wire is blocked.
- VERIFIER 2026-10-05: Series A set to amount_kind=ceiling with committed_usd=900M: the whole round is committed upfront and paid in milestone tranches; the CTO said in June 2026 that 2 of 3 milestone sets were met, so a large but undisclosed part has been received. No source gives the drawn amount, so nothing is counted as received (same treatment as Helion's $1.7B milestone money). If the project decides to count tranched VC commitments as raised, flip it back to new_money. Albuquerque $10M = $9M state LEDA + $1M city (CityDesk), not a conflict with KRQE's $9M; milestone-gated reimbursement with clawback, so ceiling until disbursement is evidenced.
- Agreement slugs sandia-national-laboratories, lawrence-livermore-national-laboratory, doe-nnsa, city-of-albuquerque are proposed slugs (not in public-funders.csv).
